description: Vardemangder labels with raw bytes swapped in after writing: the DOS cp850 remnants 0x81, 0x8D, 0x90 and 0x9D (undefined in cp1252) alone, 0x90 inside ordinary text, and cp1252's own 0x80 (euro sign) beside a remnant and alone. CP_EURO_MIXED is replaced before its prefix CP_EURO. The validity file is the fixture default (its rows name no listed item), as the replaced test delivered it.
